what: Draws one big character at the center of the cell onto a WebGL plane. When the cursor enters (.22s power3.out), the character around the cursor (radius .24 of plane height) breaks into 40×40 cell pieces that scatter outward by slightly different distances per cell and shrink, while the whole character shifts away from the cursor by up to 12% of the plane (.5s power3.out). When the cursor leaves, the pieces regroup in .55s power3.inOut and the character wobbles back into place with elastic.out(1.4,2) .75s

options.cells: Piece grid count (columns and rows), default 40
options.radius: Scatter margin (share of panel height), default .24
options.shift: Max share the whole text steps aside, default .12
options.[data-fx-part=glyph]: Text element to redraw — draws with its computed font, size and color as is (redraws when the skin changes)

note: Load _vendor/ogl@1.0.11/ogl.min.js first. On touch or reduced-motion settings it draws text only and doesn’t react. Each panel uses one WebGL context, so keep it under ten per screen

from.where: index.html .jl-letter — original Letter cell (OGL): text as a canvas texture, the shader scatters 40-cell pieces within .24 around the cursor and moves the letters aside with uDodge (max .12, radius = screen width/10), enter .22s power3.out · exit .55s power3.inOut · return from dodge elastic.out(1.4,2) .75s. The shader is newly written
